title: A buck’s castoffs
html_source:
Stephen appears to be thinking that his boots are Buck Mulligan’s castoffs or hand me downs.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Irish slang: Rhyming slang for “f—” – some “f—’s castoffs,” … But you were delighted when Esther Osvalt’s shoe went on you" – distinguishing betwixt a beauty and some unknown “buck”
